company.name: Zum
company.shortDescription: Zūm provides child transportation for school districts and busy families.
company.description:
Zūm is a provider of safe, efficient, and reliable child transportation for school districts and busy families. Zūm saves schools money and parents time by providing flexible transportation options through its network of highly vetted drivers and advanced scheduling, routing, and tracking technology.

The company currently provides children’s transportation service in the San Francisco Bay Area, all of Los Angeles, Orange County, and San Diego.

Zūm was founded in 2015 and is based in Redwood City, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Zum is researching and developing systems for fleet routing, including a fleet routing system and method that coordinates ride requestor, driver, and user devices to manage rider and stop information. Their work includes user interfaces for route identification, real-time estimated time of arrival in route selection, intelligent ride monitoring, curbside stop routing, and methods for scheduling rides for third parties and transporting vulnerable populations. These areas reflect Zum’s focus on efficient, safe, and adaptable child transportation services.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Private Equity round raised $100,000,000, or 19.86% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $58,579,482, representing 11.63% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,857,350 to $1,700,000,000, a 172.46x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 96 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 81 (+2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Motiv Electric Trucks, BusWhere, BusBoss.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
